Messages.Author: Nathan Van Eps
Messages.Body:
Okay...I have this friend who maintains that the Rack can be used to
give blood to a vampire in torpor. While the Rack does not (obviously)
deny this use on the card itself, I feel that it is against the spirit
and "traditional" use of a "Rack" (at least according to any definition
per White Wolf). Any comments on this? I checked L. Scott's search
engine and was unable to come up with any rulings relating to this...

Christian

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:


There is no official reversal of card text, so the Rack may name a
vampire in torpor as its target, and/or if its (ready) target goes to
torpor, the Rack will continue to feed it.

Gmae world seems to be that the Rack is a private hunting ground, so
the house rule that would only allow it to benefit a ready vampire
doesn't seem out of line, but it would be just a house rule.
